value.rationale: A natural unlabeled geometric sampling law admits a complete exact inverse: only three scalar raw area moments recover every side length and the scale of any nondegenerate triangle. The first two observables fail even on equal-area noncongruent isosceles triangles. The exact law and sharp normalized ranges show what geometric information enters at each order. The result is structural and not a recomputation of the previously known forced-distinct-edge law.
